name: Reference
description: Assesses how the U.S. energy markets could operate under laws and regulations current as of December 2024 and under historically observed technological growth assumptions. Price of Brent crude oil, in 2020 dollars, reaches $91 per barrel by 2050 and US GDP grows 1.8% per anum.

name: High economic growth
description: High Economic Growth case assumes the compound annual growth rate for U.S. GDP is 2.1% through 2050.

name: Low economic growth
description: Low Economic Growth case assumes the compound annual growth rate for U.S. GDP is 1.2% through 2050.

name: High oil price
description: Price of Brent crude oil, in 2020 dollars, reaches $155 per barrel by 2050

name: Low oil price
description: Price of Brent crude oil, in 2020 dollars, reaches $47 per barrel by 2050

name: High oil and gas supply
description: Lower costs and greater resource availability for oil and natural gas in the United States

name: Low oil and gas supply
description: Higher costs and fewer resource availability for oil and natural gas in the United States
